description: List the organization's notification channels (up to 100), to get the ids that channel_ids of monitors and heartbeats take. Each has id, type (TELEGRAM, WEBHOOK, SLACK or DISCORD), label, is_verified, is_active and destination_hint (a chat id, a masked address, or a webhook's scheme and host). Only a verified, active channel is alerted; an unverified one can be bound but receives nothing yet, and an inactive or unknown id cannot be bound (404). Email is not a channel: every alert also goes to the account email of whoever created the monitor or heartbeat. Channels are added only in the dashboard.
name: list_channels
title: List notification channels
